body:
**Owner decision (2026-10-03 18:42 PDT): the clinic binary ships Health Connect, on and running day 1.**

Applied at head `78ee52c0ee13d855a3d4e776e427d0260cbf962d`: `scripts/__tests__/easUpdateGuard.test.js` (from #305) now expects the clinic channel's `TGP_ANDROID_HEALTH_CONNECT` to be `'1'`, which is what this stack's `eas.json` clinic profile already sets. Production and preview stay `'0'`. Two expectation lines; no product code changed.

Local: `scripts/__tests__` + `src/config/__tests__`, 17 suites, 407/407.

Day-1 path for Health Connect (recorded in the operator handoff): land #359 -> #364 (two lenses at each exact head) -> backend flag flip `FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST=true` (currently unset = off) -> one clinic Android build (owner spend) -> Play Console Health Connect declaration (owner) -> device pass.

READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-mobile#364 @ 78ee52c0ee13d855a3d4e776e427d0260cbf962d

Piece W6 of the Health Connect split of #317 (6 pieces: #359 -> #360 -> #361 -> #362 -> #363 -> #364). Base `agent115/wear-split-5-sheet-race-tests`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 1 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11); ships in the clinic binary on day 1 (owner 10-03 18:42) with the backend flag flip FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST.

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#364 @ 78ee52c0ee13d855a3d4e776e427d0260cbf962d
- Lines: 2882 changed (source 1281 / tests 1601 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 19 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/services/health` 2496, `src/hooks/useSamsungHealthSync.test.tsx` 143, `plugins/withHealthConnectPermissionDelegate.js` 101, `src/hooks/useSamsungHealthSync.ts` 63, `src/config/__tests__` 38, `app.config.js` 27.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #317. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.
